verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses, setting up the next word: 📣
‘Tell Israel: I am Yahweh, your God. 🕊️
‘Don’t copy Egypt’s playbook from back when you lived there, or Canaan’s customs where I’m bringing you. Don’t follow their ways. 🧭
Stick with my instructions and laws; live by them. I am Yahweh your God. 📜
Keep my laws and instructions; the person who follows them will live by them. I am Yahweh. ✅
‘Here’s the boundary: nobody may have sexual relations with a close relative. I am Yahweh. ⚖️
‘Do not have sex with your father or mother. She is your mother—do not cross that line with her. 🚫
‘Do not sleep with your father’s wife; that crosses a serious family boundary. ⚠️
‘Do not sleep with your sister—whether she’s your father’s daughter or your mother’s, born at home or somewhere else. 🚫
‘Do not sleep with your granddaughter—your son’s daughter or your daughter’s. They’re your own close family. ⚠️
‘Do not sleep with your father’s wife’s daughter if your father is her father too; she’s your sister. 🚫
‘Do not sleep with your father’s sister; she’s your father’s close family. ⚠️
‘Do not sleep with your mother’s sister; she’s your mother’s close family. ⚠️
‘Do not sleep with your father’s brother. Don’t go after his wife either; she’s your aunt. 🚫
‘Do not sleep with your daughter-in-law; she’s your son’s wife. 🚫
‘Do not sleep with your brother’s wife; that crosses your brother’s boundary. ⚠️
‘Do not sleep with both a woman and her daughter, or with her granddaughter from her son or daughter. They’re close family; that’s deeply wrong. 🚫
‘Do not take a woman’s sister as an additional wife and set them up as rivals while the first sister is still alive. ⚠️
‘Do not have sex with a woman while she’s in the uncleanness of her monthly flow. 🌿
‘Do not sleep with your neighbor’s wife and make yourself unclean with her. 🚫
‘Do not hand any of your children over as a sacrifice to Molech. Don’t profane your God’s name. I am Yahweh. 🛑
‘Do not have sex with a man as you would with a woman. That is detestable. ⚠️
‘Do not have sex with an animal and make yourself unclean; no woman may lie with an animal either. That’s a perversion. 🚫
‘Don’t make yourselves unclean through any of these practices. The nations I’m driving out ahead of you became unclean doing them. ⚠️
The land became unclean, so I punished its wrongdoing; the land spat its people out. 🌍
So keep my laws and instructions. None of you may do these detestable things—not those born here or foreigners living among you. 📜
The people who lived in the land before you did all these detestable things, and the land became unclean. ⚠️
Don’t make the land unclean, or it will spit you out too, just like it did the nation before you. 🌍
‘Anyone who does these detestable things must be cut off from their people. ⚖️
So follow my requirements. Don’t pick up those detestable customs from the people before you, and don’t make yourselves unclean with them. I am Yahweh your God.’ 🕊️
